status: Fixed in source; frozen publication pending
area: Runner takeover producer and publication consumer resolve different authority stores
finding: A framework-temp runner claim is represented by an active runtime lock without a task-ledger row. takeover-publication reads that lock and excludes its allowed output scope from the foreign snapshot, while resolveSealedRunnerPublication previously read only active task ledgers. The producer therefore sealed an 18-member takeover plan and the consumer recomputed a 69-member snapshot, deterministically rejecting the valid plan as stale.
expectedBehavior: Every producer and consumer of a digest-bound publication plan must resolve one authority aggregate. Active ordinary tasks may obtain allowed files from the ledger; lock-backed framework-temp tasks must obtain them from the same actor-bound, task-bound, TTL-valid runtime lock used by queue health and takeover authorization.
evidenceOrRepro: For queue-head ATM-FRAMEWORK-TEMP-codex-gpt-5-4-mini-hotfix at sealed SHA d2d6a3fea, broker runner-sync takeover-publication authorized plan digest sha256:5580dad5 with 18 members. The following publication failed with 'plan snapshot does not match current pre-build bytes' although no competing build process existed. The task had an active runtime lock and no .atm/history/tasks row. Publication verified on 2026-08-14 against the runner's own declared input: release/atm-onefile/release-manifest.json at publication commit 8a3047111c7eb3673950ae719daed2801c151860 records sealedSourceCommit b3996c755027679acd995c4163fe96365f20468b with buildDecision fullRebuild and payloadReuse false, so the packed runner was rebuilt from that commit rather than reusing an earlier payload. The fix commit this item cites, d2d6a3fea17f363c8604e62117be4d296d9b7b53, is an ancestor of that sealed source commit, so the frozen runner carries it.
followUp: The source fix adds a fail-closed lock-backed authority fallback at the publication boundary and a focused framework-temp round-trip regression. Consolidate the duplicated broker and publication authority readers into one core deep module when the next claim-identity refactor addresses ATM-BUG-2026-08-13-017.
